description: This lab course offers an opportunity to explore research in inorganic and organometallic
chemistry. In this course, students further develop their synthetic skills and use several
characterization techniques at the intersection of multiple areas of synthetic chemistry. Emphasis
is placed on documenting lab work, interpretation of results and presentation of data. P/N only.
Offered alternate spring semesters. Prerequisites: CHEM 248, CHEM 254, and either CHEM 252 or CHEM
fullname: Laboratory Research in Inorganic and Materials Chemistry (0.25)
